test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.

She said to him, “Please fill in this form.”

options.text: She said that he had to fill in that form.
She told him to fill in this form.
She asked him to please fill in that form.
She requested him to fill in that form.

solution:
The correct answer is **'She requested him to fill in that form.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the **direct form** and it's **an imperative sentence.**
 
• Imperative sentences always express advice, order, request suggestion, etc.
 
• The following changes should be done:
 
 
• **'Said to'** will be changed into **'requested' **and the word **'please' **will be **removed.**
 
• **'Inverted commas' (,") **will be removed.
 
• The verb **(fill) **of **the second part of the sentence (reported speech)** will be changed into **"to + infinitive" (to fill).**
 
 

As per the **above-given instruction**, the sentence will be - *'She requested him to fill in that form.'*

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's understand the concept with some more examples.

 
• She said to me, "Please be quiet."
 
 
• ***She requested me to be quiet.***
 
 
 
• I said to him, "Please help me to solve this sum."
 
 
• ***I requested him to help me to solve that sum.***
